name: Aurum Jewels
description: Bespoke handcrafted gold and diamond jewellery boutique in Jaipur, specialising in timeless bridal trousseaus and custom heirloom designs.

props.headline: Handcrafted gold & diamond treasures forged for a lifetime.
props.subheadline: Immerse yourself in authentic Rajasthani artisanal artistry. From resplendent bridal sets to intimate bespoke keepsakes, every creation is hand-sculpted in the Pink City.

image.alt: Close-up of intricately handcrafted gold and uncut diamond bridal necklace against silk

props.heading: Honouring centuries of Jaipur goldsmithing heritage.
props.body:
Nestled in the cultural heart of Jaipur, Aurum Jewels celebrates the intersection of classical craftsmanship and modern grace. Our master karigars shape gold and select diamonds with unwavering precision, preserving time-honoured techniques while curating heirlooms meant to be cherished across generations.

Whether commissioning a custom bespoke ring or selecting bridal adornments for your celebratory moments, we offer an intimate boutique experience defined by warmth, integrity, and singular beauty.

image.alt: Master artisan meticulously setting diamonds into a handcrafted gold ring at a wooden jeweller bench

props.heading: Curated Collections & Atelier Services
props.intro: Every piece is thoughtfully designed and finished by hand, delivering purity, grace, and unmatched sophistication.

items.title: Bridal Trousseau Collections
items.description: Grand bridal neckpieces, jhumkas, maang tikkas, and kadas designed to harmonise with wedding ensembles and celebrate momentous occasions.

items.title: Custom Heirloom Design
items.description: Collaborate directly with our design atelier to realise unique custom gold and diamond jewellery tailored to your exact aesthetic.

items.title: Fine Diamond & Gold Adornments
items.description: Everyday luxury pieces including delicate pendant sets, bracelets, and stackable rings fashioned from refined gold and certified stones.

props.heading: Crafting Your Bespoke Jewel
props.intro: A collaborative journey from raw gold and loose gemstones to a finished masterwork.

items.title: Private Consultation
items.description: Connect with us to share your aspirations, references, stone choices, and design aesthetics.

items.title: Sketching & Material Selection
items.description: We hand-illustrate the silhouette and select ethically sourced gold and diamonds to match the design.

items.title: Handcrafted by Master Karigars
items.description: Skilled Jaipur artisans hand-set, cast, polish, and detail your piece with uncompromising care.

items.title: Presentation & Fitting
items.description: Receive your finished heirloom in boutique packaging, complete with purity verification.
